headline.purpose: Top-level wordmark and instrument-panel signage. Wide tracking, uppercase-set.

title.purpose: Title-card names inside the dock. The one cinematic type moment.

body.purpose: Descriptions and context copy, capped at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Badges, stat captions, section eyebrows. Always paired with a border or fill.

data.purpose: Counts, universe codes, runtimes - anything that is a measurement, not a sentence.

shadows.name: dock-lift
shadows.purpose: The bottom title-detail dock rising from the bottom edge.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: The stats modal, centered and heavier since it fully interrupts the map.

shadows.name: accent-glow-sm
shadows.purpose: Status dots and small selection indicators, keyed to the active continuity color.

shadows.name: accent-glow-lg
shadows.purpose: Poster frames and larger selection states, keyed to the active continuity color.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background/border/color transitions on .atlas-control hover and focus.

motion.name: dock-slide
motion.purpose: The dock's translate-y entrance/exit from the bottom edge.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: The header progress bar filling as watch state changes.

components.name: Primary Button (Mark Watched)
components.description: The dock's main CTA - fills with the active continuity color, flips text to obsidian for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #F5A623; background: #F5A623; color: #07090D; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary-check { display: inline-flex; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #071014; background: #071014; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFC466; border-color: #FFC466; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (Nav Control)
components.description: Shared control shell for every button/select/input that is not the primary CTA - the .atlas-control pattern.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2B3341; background: #10141B; color: #F7F9FC; font: 500 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #151A23; border-color: #465064; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Continuity Badge
components.description: Translucent tinted badge naming a node's continuity. Border and fill derive from the same color at low alpha.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: #FFD082; background: rgba(245,166,35,0.094); border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.4); }

components.name: Connection Badge
components.description: Fixed Phase Violet badge marking a cross-continuity nexus link - the one badge color that never varies by node.
components.css: .ds-badge-nexus { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: #E5C5FF; background: rgba(229,197,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(229,197,255,0.34); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Flat metric tile inside the watch-progress modal. No shadow - depth comes from the border and the parent modal's own lift.
components.css: .ds-card-stat { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2B3341; background: #10141B; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-stat-label { font: 500 12px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: #8F99AA; } .ds-card-stat-value { margin-top: 4px; font: 600 24px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; color: #F7F9FC; } .ds-card-stat-sub { margin-top: 4px; font: 400 14px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; color: #C1C8D3; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Shared .atlas-control input shell with an inset leading icon and trailing clear action.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input class="ds-search-field" placeholder="Search titles, years, continuity…" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search-field { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 40px 0 36px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2B3341; background: #10141B; color: #F7F9FC; font: 400 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { color: #8F99AA; } .ds-search-field:hover { background: #151A23; border-color: #465064; } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: The Dock (floating detail panel)
components.description: Signature component: a floating panel that slides up from off-screen to show one title's full detail, carrying a 1px top bar in the active continuity color.
components.html:
Avengers: Endgame

The culmination of the Infinity Saga.
components.css: .ds-dock { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #2B3341; background: rgba(12,15,21,0.97); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 -20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.58); overflow: hidden; max-width: 960px; } .ds-dock-accent { height: 4px; width: 100%; background: #F5A623; } .ds-dock-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-dock-title { font: 700 28px/1.15 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #fff; margin: 0; } .ds-dock-desc { margin-top: 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; color: #C1C8D3; }

narrative.overview: Marvel's screen continuities are threads - release-order threads, in-universe threads, cross-continuity nexus threads - and this system's job is to weave them into something a viewer can actually read at a glance. Every surface is an instrument reading, not a poster: obsidian panels, hairline borders, monospace data marks, all tuned for exactness. But the instrument is reading Marvel, so the precision carries color and light the way a control panel carries warning lamps and status glow - Signal Amber, Ion Blue, Web Red, Phase Violet - each one a real distinction in the data, never a decoration laid on top of it. This system explicitly rejects the streaming-service browse grid (no poster walls, no algorithmic rows), gamified fan-tracker chrome (no badges, XP bars, or streak counters - progress reads as a record, not a score), and the cluttered wiki/forum layout (no dense reference tables, no forum-style text dumps). Depth comes from tone and light, not decoration; density lives in the map, not the text.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian, tinted-neutral surfaces with hairline borders - never pure black or pure white.
Four named continuity colors, each tied to a real narrative distinction, never applied decoratively.
Flat map, floating instruments: the map itself stays tonal and still; only overlay panels (dock, modal) lift with shadow and glow.
Monospace marks (JetBrains Mono) for data - counts, timestamps, codes; Inter for everything read as language.
44px minimum control height everywhere, unconditionally - this is a touch-first instrument.

rules.name: The Load-Bearing Color Rule
rules.body: A color is never added for mood. If Signal Amber, Ion Blue, Web Red, or Phase Violet appear anywhere, they are naming a specific continuity or connection in the data at that exact spot - check the meaning before adding a new hue.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: If a value is countable, timed, or coded, set it in JetBrains Mono. If it's a sentence, set it in Inter. Never mix the two within one data point.

rules.name: The Flat-Map Rule
rules.body: The map canvas and its nodes never cast a drop shadow. If something needs to look lifted, it isn't part of the map - it's a floating instrument, and belongs in the shadow vocabulary.

dos: Do tie every use of Signal Amber, Ion Blue, Web Red, or Phase Violet to a real continuity/connection at that spot.
Do keep the map canvas flat - tonal layering only, elevation reserved for floating panels.
Do set countable/timed/coded values in JetBrains Mono and sentences in Inter.
Do hold every interactive control to a 44px minimum touch target, unconditionally.
Do pair every color-coded distinction with a second cue (border style, dash pattern, label, icon) so the map stays legible without color.
donts: Don't build a streaming-service poster grid - this is a map to navigate, not a catalogue to scroll.
Don't add gamified fan-tracker chrome - no badges, XP bars, streaks, or achievement animations.
Don't ship a cluttered wiki/forum layout - no dense reference tables or forum-style text dumps.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on any card or list item - the dock's full-width top bar is the one exception, and it names a continuity, not a decoration.
Don't add a drop shadow to anything on the map canvas itself.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff anywhere - every neutral is tinted obsidian.
